sources.ref: O-1/O-3 2026-10-03: nl_only ask wording + fixed disclosure line

notes: Historical wording preserved for reference profiles only. Contains busy/stuck language ('bit swamped', 'stuck on') that can interfere with a pressure manipulation (spec §7.3); not for pilot profiles.

v2 (UX round 3, AI-1/AI-2): warmer social lines so a pleasantry is answered like a coworker would, and more multiword variety per rule so the session no-repeat draw (engines.social_fallback) rarely falls through to the short defaults.

v3 (O-1/O-3): asks_intel_nl invites a typed crate ask where no picker exists; identity_probe is the fixed truthful disclosure for 'are you a bot/real?' probes (answered before generation, never model text).
